hero.title: About Thorius
hero.tagline: We find gaps through audit, solve with AI4U, and sustain with Academy.
hero.subtitle: Led by Dr. Elif Demir Uğur and M. Hakan Uğur, Thorius Education and Consulting offers an integrated transformation model that begins with consulting and audit and continues with AI4U Retail software and Thorius Academy training.

mission.title: Mission
mission.p1: To contribute to individual and organizational growth by turning the knowledge and experience of white-collar professionals into accessible, high-quality, impact-driven training.
mission.p2: Through consulting and audit we identify gaps in supply chain, planning, and HR; we solve them with AI4U Retail software; and we make transformation sustainable through Thorius Academy training. Our integrated model is built on more than 25 years of industry experience.

vision.title: Vision
vision.p1: To build a future where experience and knowledge belong not only to institutions, but to society as a whole.
vision.p2: Our vision is to create an interactive, sustainable learning ecosystem that democratizes knowledge using the opportunities of the digital age.

steps.title: Consulting & Audit
steps.description: We review your processes in supply chain, planning, and HR together and clarify competency and operational gaps.

steps.title: AI4U Retail
steps.description: We implement audit-driven solutions with our AI-powered retail software, AI4U Retail.

steps.title: Thorius Academy
steps.description: We train your teams on Thorius-LMS so solutions become lasting capability.

steps.title: Thorius Publishing & Library
steps.description: Through our Ministry-approved publishing activity, we offer expert books, e-books, and print editions via Thorius Library.

steps.title: Thorius Coaching
steps.description: We complete the journey with coaching and mentoring for individual career and leadership development.
